summary: East kerb beside a vacant block; homes 11-20 m off, steep.

best_section.where: East kerb opposite the vacant block's neighbour, before the junction

drivers.seclusion: Vacant dirt block beside the section, but dwellings sit 11 m at the north end and a house is just south; homes across the road too.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge and driveway aprons on the east side; a van can pull off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street between two cross streets; low traffic.
drivers.convention: A car parks at the south end of this kerb; no camping seen.

sun_shade: Mostly open; a few garden trees shade the verge from the west.
